summary: Architectural plan to declutter and simplify the platform UI across each view and role-based dashboard. Includes filtering out the active session user from the header team avatars to only display other organization members, removing the Split, Huddle, Graph, and Scratchpad header buttons in favor of a sleek slide-over utilities drawer, and applying modern generous rounded cards (28-32px), clean Bento layouts, and role-tailored priority widgets across Owner, Admin, PM, Member, and Client views.
